name: Biology
overview: Biology is a fascinating and diverse field of study that explores the intricate workings of living organisms across molecular, cellular, and ecosystem levels. Biologists investigate structures, functions, and behaviors to advance knowledge in biotechnology, medicine, agriculture, and environmental protection. The field utilizes cutting-edge tools like DNA sequencing and computational biology to make groundbreaking discoveries.

Play a pivotal role in conducting scientific studies and advancing knowledge in their specialized fields
Study the effects of drugs and medications on biological systems and evaluate safety and efficacy
Study living organisms and their interactions with the environment in microbiology, zoology, botany, or ecology
